info.title: Study Bid Buddy (Copilot)
info.description:
Ask Buddy with full Cosmos portfolio context (all studies) plus optional single-study detail. Use for client rollups (e.g. Alcon patients last year), study lists, and budget questions. Always call this tool for Ora bid/study questions; return the answer field.

Auth: API key in header x-copilot-key (SWA setting COPILOT_ASK_KEY). In Copilot Studio / Power Platform connector Security, set Authentication = API Key and use Maker-provided credentials so end users are never prompted.

post.summary: Ask Buddy about studies or the full portfolio
post.description: Answers questions using Cosmos study data. Supports cross-study queries by client name and year (portfolio totals) and single-study detail when studyId is known. Examples: 'How many enrolled patients with Alcon last year?', 'List studies for Regeneron', 'What are enrollment drivers on O-12345?'

question.description: The user's question about studies, clients, enrollment, or budgets

studyId.description: Optional opportunity/study id for single-study detail, e.g. O-12345

clientName.description: Optional client/sponsor filter for portfolio rollup, e.g. Alcon

year.description: Optional calendar year filter for portfolio (from study updated/imported dates), e.g. 2025

answer.description: Buddy reply to show the user

CopilotAskKey.name: x-copilot-key
CopilotAskKey.description: Shared secret — same value as SWA Application setting COPILOT_ASK_KEY. Store once on the connector connection (maker-provided). Do not pass as a chat parameter.
